QuestInfo.name: [Geardock] In the Aftermath
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Gob about what happened.
QuestInfo.1: You need to speak with Neinheart and the Alliance about the nugget of condensed ancient god power. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart agreed to leave the crystalized power with Gob so he could research a way to utilize it.
